judgement.reason: The scanner found Prisma set to SQLite with local storage, and the product's documents and built-in vector database appear to live on local disk, which Deployz's stateless containers cannot keep, but the shown lines do not prove there is no PostgreSQL option.

evidence.quote: Out of the box you get built-in agents, multi-user support, vector databases, and document pipelines — no extra configuration required.
runs locally by default with zero setup friction.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported database: Prisma configured with the SQLite provider. Deployz hosts PostgreSQL and MySQL only.
reviews.reason: No shown line proves that the production app uses a PostgreSQL or MySQL Prisma provider instead of SQLite, so the finding stands.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume ../server/storage:/app/server/storage (docker/docker-compose.yml anything-llm), volume ../collector/hotdir/:/app/collector/hotdir (docker/docker-compose.yml anything-llm), volume ../collector/outputs/:/app/collector/outputs (docker/docker-compose.yml anything-llm)
reviews.reason: The shown files do not prove that server storage, the collector hotdir or the collector outputs hold only cache or temporary data, or that S3 replaces them.
